source: Family History of Diabetes
quote: A family history (parent, brother, or sister) with diabetes.

source: Physical Inactivity
quote: Physical inactivity—exercising less than 3 times a week.

source: High Blood Pressure
quote: High blood pressure measuring 140/90 or higher.

source: Prior History of Diabetes During Pregnancy
quote: Prior history of diabetes during pregnancy.

source: Birth of at Least One Baby Weighing More Than 9 Pounds

source: Ethnicity
quote: African American, American Indian, Asian American, Pacific Islander, or Hispanic American/Latino heritage.

source: Increased physical activity
quote: Increased physical activity can prevent or delay diabetes and may return blood glucose levels to normal.

source: Weight loss
quote: Being overweight or obese is a leading cause of type 2 diabetes. Being overweight can keep your body from making and using insulin properly.
